description: This file defines the LogWrapper class which implements the LogNode interface. It wraps Android's native Log utility to allow logging messages with various priorities, tags, and exception information, and supports chaining multiple log nodes for flexible logging targets.

classes.name: LogWrapper
classes.description: A helper class that wraps Android's native Log utility, implementing the LogNode interface and enabling logging at different levels with chaining support.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the linked list.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode in the linked list.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Logs a message with a specific priority, tag, and optional throwable; forwards the log to the next node if available.
